This editorial illustration depicts a man’s head and shoulders centered against a textured tan background. The man has a bald forehead, short brown hair, and a dark, bushy beard. A separate arm and hand reach horizontally from the right side of the frame, with the palm and fingers covering the man's eyes. This hand has dark skin and wears a black round-faced wristwatch with a dark strap. The man wears a white collared shirt under a dark jacket.

At the top, the large black word "TEMPO" is printed. Above it, white text reads "PUCUK BERINGIN BEREBUT RESTU" and "BANJIR MINYAK DI PANTAI KARAWANG". Below the logo, smaller, partially obscured text reads "DAN PERLU". In the bottom-right corner, large white block text states "NOVEL BASWEDAN: POLISI TAHU SAYA AKAN DISERANG". The the bottom-left corner features a red border, publication details including "5-11 AGUSTUS 2019", "RP 45.000", "WWW.TEMPO.CO", and a barcode with numbers "9 770126 427302" and "00024". A solid red border runs along the left edge.
